english.meaning: a filler that links to the next thing the speaker says, as in 噉𠻺 'so then'
english.note: Used in 噉𠻺. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Some salespeople don’t know how to use so many machines. That’s pretty common.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉有啲售貨員係唔識用咁多機𠸏。噉𠻺，都係好普遍𠸏。
